method.time_basis: UTC created_at inclusive bounds; one record per distinct run ID, not per execution attempt
method.enumeration: Nonoverlapping date slices below 1000 results; exact per-slice totals and all expected pages checked; no duplicate run IDs. Daily counts independently reconciled.
method.digest_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 Python json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=False). Run IDs and public metadata projection ordered by numeric ID.
method.digest_limitation: Documentary identity of collected metadata, not independent attestation. Full raw API responses are deliberately not published.
